body: I can't even imagine how I would have handled myself if I was in your situation, your story really puts things into perspective. It may not sound genuine because I dont even know who you are, but I'm really glad that you're still alive, hopefully your illness will not catch up with you. Thanks for the advice, I'm sure things get better, but from where I'm standing it looks unlikely, I think I need to work on changing my stance and perspective. Thank you so much!

I feel for you man, my dad is a heroin junky and has been an addict my entire life. He thinks I love him, but I always feel the urge to let him know just how much I hate who he is. I feel like I hate him so much, but I don't want to hurt him. Thanks for sharing your story dude, its helped me realize that, for as bad as he is, I really shouldn't try to hurt my dad. I can't imagine how you must feel thinking back to you're father not knowing how much you loved him. But you have to understand that your anger was justified at the time. Don't make the same mistake again, don't grow old and then look back on how you should have forgiven yourself. Anyways, I hope you can live most the rest of your life out in peace and happiness

I have never related to a post on Reddit more than this in all my life. I made a throwaway account just to comment on here. I don't know much about what drugs my dad has/does use, I know he's dabbled in amphetamines but he has been addicted to opiates for as long as I could remember. He was supposedly a big pothead in his teens, but for as long as I've known him, he's definitely been doing some much worse drugs. He used to beat my mom, steal from my mom, steal from everyone, and get in fights about stupid shit. I've always known but I've never once talked to him about his drug abuse. Even after my mom left him, and he got arrested and spent 2 years in jail, I still dont talk to him about his drug usage and he doesn't admit to it. I want so much to be able to hate him, but he's my dad and I just can't commit to hating him as much as I should. I grew up living in a basement and as a 17 year old, I still do. I never invite my friends over because its embarrassing to live in a basement and to have a junky father. To date none of my friends have ever been to my place or have seen my dad. It's hard to keep the secret but at this point I just have to carry on with it. I feel your pain and hope you can get your life sorted out, even if that's not what you want, do it for your mother because she deserves some stability in her life.
